name: Wicked Blow (Combat)
body:
When you catch an enemy off guard you impair them with a burst of magical force.

Prerequisite(s): Sneak attack 3d6, Arcane Strike

Benefit(s): When you deal damage to a creature with sneak attack while using your Arcane Strike feat you may reduce the sneak attack by a number of damage dice to gain one of the following effects.

The target of your sneak attack takes a -2 penalty to attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
The target of your sneak attack is flat-footed until your next turn.
The target of your sneak attack is staggered until your next turn or until they take damage, whichever comes first.
The target of your sneak attack suffers the effects of bestow curse, with a duration of 24 hours.
